products.name: HiFi Long-Read Sequencing Systems
products.description: Integrated sequencing platforms (Revio, Vega, Sequel) based on SMRT technology, manufactured in-house, that enable highly accurate, long-read DNA and RNA sequencing for research and clinical applications. Delivered as physical instruments with embedded software and automation.

products.name: Sequencing Consumables (SMRT Cells and Reagents)
products.description: Proprietary consumables including SMRT Cells (nanofluidic chips) and reagent kits for DNA/RNA extraction, library preparation, and sequencing, required for operating PacBio sequencing systems. Manufactured and sold as physical products for each sequencing run.

products.name: Application-Specific Sequencing Kits and Panels
products.description: Specialized kits and panels (e.g., Kinnex RNA kits, PureTarget panels) designed for targeted sequencing applications such as RNA sequencing, single-cell analysis, and repeat expansion analysis. Sold as physical kits with companion software for specific research needs.

products.name: Sequencing Services
products.description: Laboratory services performed for customers, where genetic samples are sequenced using PacBio systems and the resulting data is provided to the customer. Delivered as a service rather than a product, leveraging in-house instruments and expertise.

products.name: Automotive Replacement Parts
products.description: A comprehensive portfolio of brand name, OEM, and owned brand automotive replacement parts for domestic and imported cars, vans, SUVs, and light and heavy-duty trucks, distributed through physical stores, e-commerce, and delivery to professional customers. Products are physically manufactured and require regulated supply chain and inventory management.

products.name: Automotive Batteries and Battery Accessories
products.description: Sales of automotive batteries and related accessories under both owned and third-party brands, distributed through retail stores and online channels. Products are physically manufactured and require regulated handling and recycling.

products.name: Automotive Maintenance Items and Fluids
products.description: A wide range of automotive maintenance products such as motor oil, transmission fluid, antifreeze, lubricants, and filters, sold through stores and online. These are physical goods requiring regulated storage and disposal.

products.name: Automotive Accessories and Chemicals
products.description: A variety of automotive accessories (e.g., floor mats, seat covers, lighting, electronics) and chemicals (e.g., cleaners, waxes, additives), sold through stores and online. These are physical products requiring inventory management and, in some cases, regulated handling.

products.name: Automotive Tools and Equipment
products.description: Hand and specialty tools, as well as loaner tool programs, provided to customers for vehicle maintenance and repair, available for purchase or temporary use through stores. These are physical products requiring inventory and logistics management.

products.name: Automotive Recycling Services
products.description: Collection and recycling programs for used lead-acid batteries, used oil, and other recyclable automotive items, provided at most store locations as a service to customers. This service is regulated and involves third-party vendors for proper disposal.

products.name: In-Store Automotive Services
products.description: Free in-store services such as battery and wiper installation, check engine light scanning, and electrical system testing, provided by store personnel to support customer vehicle maintenance. These services require in-person human labor and regulated equipment.

products.name: Business Lending
products.description: Origination, servicing, and sale of various business loans including SBA 7(a), SBA 504, C&I (including ABL), and CRE loans to independent business owners. Loans are originated digitally, often sold in secondary markets, and require significant underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Alternative Lending Program (ALP) Loans
products.description: Origination and sale of non-SBA, longer-term, higher-rate C&I loans for business owners who do not qualify for SBA programs. Loans are funded via company capital and warehouse lines, and may be securitized or sold to joint ventures.

products.name: Depository Services
products.description: Provision of digital business and retail deposit accounts, including high yield savings, CDs, and business checking, through a digital direct bank platform with no branch network. Deposits are gathered and serviced via proprietary software solutions.

products.name: Electronic Payment Processing
products.description: Credit and debit card processing, check approval, ACH services, and related payment processing equipment and software for merchants, delivered via direct and indirect sales channels. Includes specialized solutions for industries such as taxi cabs and cloud-based point-of-sale systems for retail and hospitality.

products.name: Payroll and Benefits Solutions
products.description: Provision of payroll management, tax reporting, and related payment services to business owners, integrated with digital business portals for direct payroll execution. Delivered via proprietary software and digital interfaces.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Retail and wholesale brokerage of commercial, health/benefits, and personal lines insurance products to business owners, leveraging technology for streamlined application and integration with lending products.

products.name: Technology Solutions (via Referral)
products.description: Referral-based offering of technology solutions such as cloud computing, data backup, storage, retrieval, IT consulting, and web services, provided by a third-party partner (IPM.com).

products.name: Third-Party Loan Servicing and Origination Services
products.description: Provision of outsourced loan servicing and origination solutions, including credit analysis, structuring, packaging, closing compliance, and servicing, to affiliates and external third parties such as banks, credit unions, and government agencies.

products.name: Navacaprant (NMRA-140)
products.description: A novel, oral, once-daily selective kappa opioid receptor (KOR) antagonist developed as a monotherapy for major depressive disorder (MDD). It is produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered as an oral medication, requiring regulatory approval before commercialization.

products.name: NMRA-511
products.description: A highly selective, novel vasopressin 1a receptor (V1aR) antagonist developed for the treatment of agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease. It is a small molecule drug produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and intended for oral administration.

products.name: NMRA-898 (M4 PAM)
products.description: A highly potent and selective muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M4 positive allosteric modulator (PAM) developed for the treatment of schizophrenia and other neuropsychiatric disorders. It is a small molecule drug manufactured for oral administration.

products.name: NMRA-215
products.description: A highly brain-penetrant, oral NLRP3 inhibitor in development for the treatment of obesity. It is a small molecule drug produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing and intended for oral administration.

products.name: NMRA-GCase
products.description: A glucocerebrosidase (GCase) activator program aimed at elevating GCase enzyme activity for the treatment of Parkinson’s Disease. This is a small molecule therapeutic in preclinical development, produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: NMRA-CK1δ
products.description: A casein kinase 1 isoform delta (CK1δ) inhibitor program intended for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). This is a small molecule drug in preclinical development, produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: Equipment Rental
products.description: Rental of a large and diverse fleet of construction, industrial, and specialty equipment, including general construction equipment, aerial work platforms, trench safety, power and HVAC, fluid solutions, mobile storage, modular office space, surface protection mats, and general tools. Equipment is provided on an hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly basis and requires significant physical assets, logistics, and maintenance infrastructure.

products.name: Sales of Used Equipment
products.description: Sale of used rental equipment through multiple channels, including national and export sales forces, auctions, brokers, direct to manufacturers, and online. This business line leverages the company's large rental fleet and requires asset management and resale logistics.

products.name: Sales of New Equipment
products.description: Sale of new equipment such as aerial lifts, reach forklifts, telehandlers, compressors, and generators from leading manufacturers. This is location-dependent and involves distribution and sales operations.

products.name: Contractor Supplies Sales
products.description: Sale of contractor supplies including construction consumables, tools, small equipment, and safety supplies. This line involves procurement and distribution of consumable goods to customers in construction and industrial sectors.

products.name: Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of repair and maintenance services and sale of parts for equipment owned by customers. This service is delivered through skilled labor and parts inventory management.

products.name: Total Control® Equipment Management Platform
products.description: Provision of a proprietary software application (Total Control®) that enables customers to monitor and manage all their equipment needs, including integration with customers' enterprise resource planning systems. This is a digital product delivered via software and technology infrastructure.

products.name: AI, Cloud, and Data Center Networking
products.description: High-performance Ethernet switches and networking platforms designed for large-scale AI, cloud, and data center environments, manufactured using merchant silicon and delivered as physical hardware with integrated software.

products.name: Campus Networking Solutions
products.description: Modular and fixed-form-factor campus spine switches, Power-over-Ethernet leaf switches, and Wi-Fi access points for enterprise campus environments, managed through cloud-based software and delivered as physical and wireless hardware.

products.name: Cloud-Grade Routing Platforms
products.description: High-performance routing platforms with high port density, deep buffers, integrated DWDM, and wire-speed encryption for multi-cloud, data center interconnect, and enterprise edge routing, delivered as physical appliances with embedded software.

products.name: SD-WAN Solutions
products.description: Cloud-delivered SD-WAN solutions, including the VeloCloud portfolio, providing secure, optimized WAN connectivity for branch and distributed offices, delivered as software and hardware appliances.

products.name: Network Management and AI Ops Software (CloudVision, EOS, NetDL)
products.description: Software platforms for network management, automation, observability, and AI-driven operations, including CloudVision, EOS, and Network Data Lake (NetDL), delivered as cloud-based or on-premises software solutions.

products.name: Network Security Solutions (Zero Trust, NDR, NAC)
products.description: Comprehensive suite of network security solutions including zero trust architectures, network detection and response (NDR), and network access control (NAC), delivered as integrated software and hardware for securing enterprise networks.

products.name: Network Monitoring and Packet Broker Solutions (DMF)
products.description: Network monitoring and packet broker solutions, such as DANZ Monitoring Fabric (DMF), for traffic visibility and analysis, delivered as software and hardware appliances for enterprise and service provider networks.

products.name: Customer Support and Maintenance Services (A-Care Services)
products.description: Global customer support and maintenance services, including technical assistance, product replacement, software updates, and spare parts logistics, delivered by support engineers and logistics partners.

products.name: Researgency AI Platform-as-a-Service
products.description: A dedicated, on-premises AI infrastructure platform designed for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, enabling secure deployment of agentic AI systems within client environments. Delivered as a platform-as-a-service with implementation support, maintenance subscriptions, and data analytics services; requires integration with customer data and compliance with regulatory frameworks.

products.name: MSC-S Biologics Asset Portfolio (including KPI-012 and KPI-014)
products.description: A portfolio of proprietary mesenchymal stem cell secretome (MSC-S) biologics, including clinical-stage and preclinical candidates (KPI-012 for persistent corneal epithelial defects and KPI-014 for inherited retinal degenerative diseases). Assets are currently being preserved for potential monetization via licensing, sale, or collaboration, rather than active development or commercialization.

products.name: ATM and ITM Hardware
products.description: Manufacture, assembly, distribution, and maintenance of automated teller machines (ATMs), interactive teller machines (ITMs), cash dispensers, and cash recycling ATMs for financial institutions and retailers. Delivered as physical hardware, often bundled with software or services.

products.name: ATM and ITM Software
products.description: Development, installation, support, and operation of ATM management and transaction software (including the AMP platform) for proprietary and third-party hardware, delivered as cloud-based or on-premise solutions on a recurring subscription basis.

products.name: ATM as a Service (ATMaaS) and Managed Services
products.description: End-to-end outsourced management of ATM and ITM channels for financial institutions and retailers, including back office, cash management, software management, deployment, transaction processing, and maintenance, typically for a monthly or per-transaction fee.

products.name: ATM Network Access (including Allpoint Network)
products.description: Provision of access to a large, surcharge-free ATM network (including the Allpoint network) for banks, credit unions, fintechs, and retailers, enabling cash withdrawals, deposits, and digital value conversion for their customers, with revenue from transaction and branding fees.

products.name: ATM Branding Services
products.description: Branding of ATMs and transactions (physically and digitally) for financial institutions and fintechs, allowing them to expand geographic presence and offer surcharge-free access to their customers, with Atleos earning branding fees and increased transaction volumes.

products.name: Bitcoin Purchase and Sale via LibertyX
products.description: Provision of Bitcoin buying and selling services to consumers through the LibertyX platform, integrated with ATMs and kiosks, requiring regulatory compliance and money transmitter licenses.

products.name: Digital Value Conversion (ReadyCode)
products.description: Enabling conversion between digital value (e.g., stored-value debit, digital balances) and cash at ATMs and kiosks via the ReadyCode product, supporting fintechs and alternative payment networks.

products.name: Telecommunications and Technology Managed Services
products.description: Provision of managed network and infrastructure services, including design, deployment, and support for modern network technologies (e.g., SD-WAN, NFV, wireless LAN, optical networking, edge networks) for enterprise clients across industries, delivered via direct relationships with communications service providers and technology manufacturers.

products.name: Debt Portfolio Purchasing and Recovery
products.description: Acquisition of portfolios of nonperforming and distressed consumer receivables (including credit card, auto, utilities, telecom, and other loans) at a discount, followed by management and collection through legal and voluntary channels. This involves proprietary valuation, regulatory compliance, and a mix of in-house and third-party collection methods across multiple geographies.

products.name: Debt Servicing and Portfolio Management Services
products.description: Provision of debt servicing and portfolio management services to credit originators for non-performing loans, including outsourced receivables management on a fee basis. Services are delivered through operational expertise, compliance infrastructure, and technology platforms.

products.name: Credit Card Issuance and Revenue Programs
products.description: Operation of credit card acquisition programs, including the issuance of credit cards (notably in Canada) and earning revenue from credit card accounts. This involves regulatory compliance, partnership with financial institutions, and ongoing account management.

products.name: Bezuclastinib (CGT9486)
products.description: A highly selective small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting KIT mutations, developed and manufactured through chemical synthesis, intended for the treatment of Systemic Mastocytosis (SM) and Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GIST). Delivered as an oral pharmaceutical product, pending regulatory approval for commercial sale.

products.name: FGFR2/3 Inhibitor (CGT4859)
products.description: A novel, orally administered small molecule inhibitor targeting FGFR2/3 mutations, produced via chemical synthesis, intended for the treatment of cancers such as advanced cholangiocarcinoma. Currently in Phase 1 clinical trials.

products.name: CNS-Penetrant ErbB2 Inhibitor (CGT4255)
products.description: A small molecule inhibitor designed to target mutant ErbB2 (HER2) mutations, including those causing brain metastases in solid tumors. Manufactured chemically and formulated for CNS penetration, currently in Phase 1 clinical trials.

products.name: PI3Kα Inhibitor (CGT6297)
products.description: A wild-type-sparing, small molecule PI3Kα inhibitor targeting prevalent oncogenic mutations in solid tumors, including breast cancer. Chemically synthesized and intended for oral administration, with IND-enabling studies completed and Phase 1 trials planned.

products.name: KRAS Inhibitor
products.description: A preclinical small molecule inhibitor targeting KRAS mutations, which are common in cancers such as colorectal, lung, and pancreatic cancer. Developed through chemical synthesis, with IND submission planned.

products.name: JAK2 Inhibitor
products.description: A preclinical, wild-type-sparing small molecule inhibitor selective for JAK2 V617F mutations, intended for BCR-ABL-negative myeloproliferative neoplasms. Developed via chemical synthesis, with IND submission planned.

products.name: Wet Shave Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed razors, razor systems (handles and refillable blades), disposable razors, and shaving gels and creams for men and women, sold globally under brands such as Schick, Wilkinson Sword, Edge, Skintimate, Billie, and private label/value brands. Production involves physical manufacturing and global distribution.

products.name: Sun Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed sun protection products including sunscreens and after-sun products for general, sport, kids, baby, tanning, and after sun categories, primarily under the Banana Boat and Hawaiian Tropic brands. Products are produced through regulated manufacturing processes and distributed globally.

products.name: Feminine Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed feminine hygiene products including tampons, pads, and liners under brands such as Playtex, Stayfree, Carefree, and o.b. Products are produced using specialized manufacturing processes and distributed primarily in North America.

products.name: Men’s Grooming and Skin Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed men’s grooming and skin care products, including facial cleansers, moisturizers, beard, hair, and body care, under brands such as Bulldog, Jack Black, and Cremo. Products are produced through physical manufacturing and distributed globally, including luxury and masstige segments.

products.name: Antibacterial Hand Wipes and Related Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed antibacterial hand wipes and related portable hygiene products under the Wet Ones brand. Products are produced through physical manufacturing and distributed primarily in the U.S.

products.name: Engineered Steel Water Transmission Pipeline Systems
products.description: Large-diameter, high-pressure welded steel pipeline systems, including spiral welded and bar-wrapped concrete cylinder pipe, manufactured to project specifications for water transmission, hydroelectric, wastewater, and industrial applications. Products are custom engineered, fabricated, lined, and coated, and delivered to job sites for installation.

products.name: Steel Casing Pipe (Permalok®)
products.description: Proprietary steel casing pipe with a press-fit interlocking connection system, primarily used in trenchless construction and microtunneling projects. Manufactured using advanced joining technologies for specialized installation requirements.

products.name: Precast and Reinforced Concrete Infrastructure Products
products.description: Precast and reinforced concrete products such as reinforced concrete pipe (RCP), manholes, box culverts, vaults, catch basins, and other structural components, manufactured using dry or wet cast methods for stormwater, sanitary sewer, and utility applications. Products are made to ASTM and AASHTO specifications and delivered ready for installation.

products.name: Lined and Corrosion-Resistant Precast Products
products.description: Precast concrete products with internal liners (HDPE, polypropylene, FRP) for enhanced corrosion resistance, including lined RCP, lined manholes, and FRP panel systems for rehabilitating wastewater structures. Manufactured and assembled in controlled environments for sanitary sewer and wastewater applications.

products.name: Pre-Assembled Water, Wastewater, and Stormwater Management Systems
products.description: Pre-assembled systems housed in precast concrete or steel, including pump lift stations, water meter assemblies, break tank systems, backflow prevention systems, oil-water separators, and interceptors. Units are built and tested in-house, delivered ready to install, and incorporate OEM components and UL 508A certified control panels.

products.name: Allurion Smart Capsule (Procedureless Intragastric Balloon)
products.description: A swallowable, procedureless intragastric balloon system for weight loss, manufactured in-house, that does not require surgery, endoscopy, or anesthesia for placement. The device is placed during a short outpatient visit and naturally passes after several months, designed to reduce food intake and promote long-term weight loss.

products.name: Allurion Virtual Care Suite (VCS)
products.description: A digital therapeutic platform that includes AI-powered remote patient monitoring, a proprietary behavior change program, secure messaging, video telehealth, and integration with connected scales and wearables. Delivered via a mobile app and provider dashboard, it supports both patients and healthcare providers in weight management.

products.name: Allurion Connected Scale and Mobile App
products.description: A connected digital scale and mobile application provided to Allurion Program patients, enabling tracking of weight, muscle mass, body fat, activity, and other health metrics, as well as secure communication and access to digital coaching and educational content. The app integrates with wearables and supports multi-language use.

products.name: Cloud Transformation and Management Platform (CloudEz)
products.description: An enterprise multi-cloud transformation and management platform that enables healthcare and life sciences organizations to manage, automate, and secure their cloud infrastructure across private, hybrid, and public clouds. Delivered as a proprietary software platform with automation and compliance frameworks, often as SaaS or managed service.

products.name: Healthcare Data Analytics and Data Science Platform (DataEz)
products.description: A cloud-based data analytics and data science platform for healthcare and life sciences organizations, enabling ingestion, processing, analysis, and visualization of large-scale, disparate healthcare data. Delivered as a SaaS subscription or solution, supporting regulatory compliance and advanced analytics.

products.name: Healthcare Information Management System (Ezovion)
products.description: A cloud-based hospital and healthcare information management system (HIMS) that digitizes clinical, administrative, and financial operations for hospitals and clinics. Delivered as a modular SaaS platform integrating EHR, billing, labs, pharmacy, telehealth, and analytics.

products.name: AI-Powered Medical Document Management (Readabl.AI)
products.description: A cloud-based AI/ML platform that automates recognition, extraction, and integration of healthcare information from unstructured documents, faxes, and reports into EHR systems. Delivered as a SaaS solution via public cloud marketplaces.

products.name: AI-Powered Mental Wellness Platform (Ziloy.AI)
products.description: A digital mental wellness platform leveraging AI and generative AI to deliver personalized mental health support, self-care tools, and wellness programs for individuals and organizations. Delivered as a secure, cloud-based SaaS solution.

products.name: Cloud IT Services
products.description: Comprehensive cloud IT services including multi-cloud advisory, DevOps/DevSecOps, cloud security operations, backup and disaster recovery, and ransomware protection for healthcare organizations. Delivered through certified professionals as managed and professional services.

products.name: Healthcare IT Services
products.description: A suite of IT services for hospitals and healthcare centers, including EHR implementation and optimization, managed services, interoperability assessments, data assessment and toolsets, and clinical and training consulting. Delivered as professional and managed services by specialized teams.

products.name: Healthcare Interoperability Solutions
products.description: Solutions and services to enable interoperability of healthcare data across systems, including assessments, roadmap development, and integration using standards like HL7 and FHIR. Delivered via proprietary platforms and consulting services.

products.name: Hardscapes Products
products.description: Includes pavers, natural stone, blocks, and other durable materials for outdoor living spaces. These are physically manufactured products distributed through branches and direct distribution, requiring significant yard space and logistics for delivery.

products.name: Irrigation Supplies
products.description: Comprises sprinkler heads, irrigation pipe and tubing, controllers, valves, fittings, and micro-irrigation or drip products. These are physical products sourced from major manufacturers and distributed via branches and direct distribution.

products.name: Fertilizer and Control Products
products.description: Includes fertilizer, grass seed, combination products (pesticides on a fertilizer carrier), herbicides, fungicides, rodenticides, and other pesticides. These are regulated, physical products distributed through branches and direct distribution.

products.name: Landscape Accessories
products.description: Includes mulches, soil amendments, drainage pipe, tools, sod, and related items. These are physical products typically sold in combination with other landscape supplies and require warehousing and logistics for distribution.

products.name: Nursery Goods
products.description: Comprises live plants such as shrubs, trees, perennials, annuals, bulbs, and nursery stock in various forms and sizes. These are living products requiring specialized storage and handling at branches with yard and greenhouse facilities.

products.name: Outdoor Lighting Products
products.description: Includes lighting fixtures (path, area, accent, up, down, well, hardscape, deck, underwater, bistro, and holiday), LED lamps, wire, transformers, and accessories. These are manufactured electrical products distributed through branches and direct distribution.

products.name: Ice Melt Products
products.description: Includes various ice melt formulations for use in landscape and property maintenance. These are physical, chemical products distributed through branches, often seasonally.

products.name: Proprietary Branded Products (LESCO, Pro-Trade, Solstice, SiteOne Green Tech, Portfolio)
products.description: A range of landscape supply products sold under proprietary brands, including fertilizers, control products, turf seed, application equipment, lighting, synthetic turf, natural stone, irrigation management solutions, and premium plant varieties. These are manufactured or sourced products with exclusive branding, distributed through branches and online.

products.name: Value-Added Consultative and Project Services
products.description: Includes consultative services such as product selection and support, design and implementation assistance, project planning, irrigation project take-offs, quoting, estimating, and technical/business management seminars (SiteOne University). Delivered by staff with industry expertise, these services support product sales and customer business growth.

products.name: Direct Distribution Services
products.description: Provides point-to-point logistics and sourcing for bulk quantities of landscape products between suppliers and customers, including inventory management and delivery. This service leverages supplier relationships and logistics infrastructure to broker large orders without maintaining inventory.

products.name: Custom-Engineered Vacuum and Heat Transfer Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures custom vacuum and heat transfer equipment such as ejectors, surface condensers, process condensers, liquid ring pumps, heat exchangers, and nozzles for critical applications in Defense and Energy & Process industries. Production involves complex engineering, fabrication, and assembly at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Specialty Turbomachinery Products
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures custom turbomachinery including turbines, compressors, alternators, and specialty pumps for Defense, Space, Aerospace, Cryogenic, and New Energy markets. Production requires advanced engineering, precision manufacturing, and integration of proprietary technologies.

products.name: Cryogenic Pumps and Systems
products.description: Produces cryogenic pumps and related systems for applications in Space, New Energy, and Medical markets, including rocket propulsion, fuel handling, and life support. These products require specialized manufacturing for low-temperature, high-reliability environments.

products.name: Thermal Management Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures thermal management equipment such as pumps, blowers, fans, and drive electronics for Defense, Energy & Process, and Space industries, supporting cooling and heat transfer in mission-critical systems. Production involves custom engineering and integration with customer systems.

products.name: Rocket Propulsion and Space Systems
products.description: Provides propulsion and fluid management systems for space applications, including turbopumps, fuel pumps, blowers, and life support system components. These are engineered-to-order products for commercial and government space programs, requiring advanced manufacturing and compliance with stringent standards.

products.name: Inhaled Migraine Therapeutic (PUR3100)
products.description: An investigational orally inhaled formulation of dihydroergotamine (DHE) for the acute treatment of migraine, produced using the iSPERSE™ dry powder delivery platform and intended for self-administration via inhalation. Manufacturing relies on contract manufacturing organizations for clinical and potential commercial supply.

products.name: Inhaled Kinase Inhibitor for COPD and Respiratory Diseases (PUR1800)
products.description: An investigational orally inhaled narrow spectrum kinase inhibitor (RV1162) for the treatment of acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) and other inflammatory respiratory diseases, formulated with iSPERSE™ technology and delivered as a dry powder via inhalation. Manufacturing and clinical development are conducted through external partners and contract organizations.

products.name: Inhaled Antifungal Therapeutic (PUR1900)
products.description: An investigational inhaled dry powder formulation of itraconazole for the prevention and treatment of pulmonary fungal infections and allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA) in patients with asthma and cystic fibrosis, produced using iSPERSE™ technology and delivered via inhalation. Commercialization and development are conducted in partnership with Cipla outside the US, with manufacturing outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: iSPERSE™ Inhaled Drug Delivery Platform (Out-Licensing/Partnerships)
products.description: A proprietary engineered dry powder delivery technology platform enabling inhaled delivery of small molecules and biologics for local or systemic therapy, offered for out-licensing or partnership to pharmaceutical companies seeking to develop new inhaled therapeutics. The platform is based on particle engineering and is supported by a broad patent portfolio.

products.name: PALI-2108 (Oral PDE4 Inhibitor Prodrug)
products.description: A once-daily, oral prodrug designed for targeted delivery of PDE4 inhibition to the terminal ileum and colon, produced via chemical synthesis and formulated for local bioactivation in the lower intestine. Delivered as an oral tablet, it is intended for the treatment of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC), Crohn’s disease (CD), and fibrostenosing Crohn’s disease (FSCD).

products.name: Biomarker Assays for Precision Medicine in IBD
products.description: Biomarker-based diagnostic assays developed to identify patients likely to respond to PALI-2108, using clinical and multiomics data. These are laboratory-developed tests intended for regulatory approval and use in patient selection for targeted therapy.

products.name: LB1148 (for Newsoara in China)
products.description: A drug asset supplied under exclusive agreement to Newsoara for development and commercialization in China, produced via third-party manufacturing. The company acts as the exclusive supplier for this product in the territory, though it ceased its own development in August 2023.

products.name: Biometric Software Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive software platforms and frameworks for biometric enrollment, identification, authentication, and lifecycle management, delivered as perpetual, fixed-term, or SaaS licenses. These solutions are built on modular, standards-compliant components and are used by government and commercial customers for secure identity management.

products.name: Automated Biometric Identification Systems (ABIS)
products.description: Large-scale, highly scalable biometric identification and deduplication platforms (e.g., AwareABIS) for one-to-many and one-to-one matching using fingerprint, face, and iris recognition, primarily for government and law enforcement applications.

products.name: Law Enforcement Biometric Identification Solutions
products.description: Software products (e.g., AFIX suite) for small to moderate scale law enforcement biometric identification, including fingerprint, palmprint, and latent print matching, designed for crime scene investigation and forensic analysis.

products.name: Biometric Integration and Workflow Platforms
products.description: Integration platforms (e.g., Awareness Platform/BioSP) and browser-based solutions (e.g., WebEnroll) for managing biometric data processing, workflow, and transaction management in distributed and large-scale environments, supporting multiple biometric modalities.

products.name: Biometric SDKs, APIs, and Software Components
products.description: Modular software development kits, APIs, and applications (e.g., Nexa, AwareXM) providing biometric search, matching, enrollment, and image processing capabilities for integration into customer or partner systems.

products.name: Imaging Compression Software
products.description: Image compression software (e.g., Aware JPEG 2000) based on the JPEG2000 standard, used primarily for compressing, storing, and displaying medical and advanced images.

products.name: Software Maintenance Services
products.description: Ongoing technical support, software updates, and product enhancements for customers purchasing software products and solutions, available via annual contracts or as part of subscription offerings.

products.name: Program Management and Software Engineering Services
products.description: Professional services including project management, system and architecture design, software customization, integration, and installation, delivered as fixed-fee engagements for government and commercial customers.

products.name: Small Tactical Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS)
products.description: Physically manufactured, American-made small drones designed for defense, public safety, and commercial applications, providing tactical capabilities such as intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and situational awareness. Delivered as integrated hardware and software platforms, including models like Black Widow™, Teal 2, and FANG™.

products.name: Long-Endurance VTOL Fixed-Wing Unmanned Aircraft Systems
products.description: Manufactured vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) fixed-wing drones, such as the FlightWave Edge 130, designed for extended-range intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions, with tool-free payload swapping and operation in challenging environments.

products.name: Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs) and Weapons Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured, battle-tested uncrewed surface vessels equipped with modular weapons and sensor payloads, designed for maritime defense applications including ISR and tactical strike, with integration capabilities for aerial UAS deployment.

products.name: Autonomous Swarming Drone Software
products.description: Digitally delivered software enabling distributed autonomy and swarming capabilities for unmanned systems, allowing drones to perform collaborative missions with decentralized control, resilience to communication loss, and dynamic mission behaviors.

products.name: Integrated Drone Navigation and AI Software
products.description: Digitally delivered software solutions, such as Palantir’s Visual Navigation (VNav), integrated into drones to enable advanced navigation (including GPS-denied environments), AI-enabled autonomy, and enhanced mission effectiveness for defense and security operations.

products.name: Hardware and Software Product Design and Engineering Services
products.description: Comprehensive design, engineering, and development services for consumer and industrial electronics, including medical devices, smart displays, vending machines, lighting, security systems, cameras, wearables, and vehicle controls. Services are delivered through in-house teams and include electrical, mechanical, software, industrial, UX/UI, and optical engineering, as well as IoT system architecture and program management. Delivery is project-based, from concept through prototype to final design for manufacturing.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Management (Solana and Solana Ecosystem Tokens)
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and management of Solana (SOL) and other Solana ecosystem digital assets as a primary treasury reserve asset. Revenue is generated through staking, participation in DeFi protocols, and strategic partnerships within the Solana ecosystem. Activities include direct market purchases, staking via validators, liquid staking, and active capital markets and onchain strategies. Delivery is financial and digital, requiring capital allocation and digital asset management infrastructure.

products.name: Precious Metals Bullion Products
products.description: Physical gold, silver, platinum, palladium, and copper bullion products (bars, coins, wafers, grain, rounds) sourced from sovereign and private mints, fabricated in-house or distributed via wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. Requires physical manufacturing, regulated sourcing, and global logistics.

products.name: Numismatic and Collectible Coins & Currency
products.description: Rare, collectible, and certified coins and currency, including modern and historical issues, sold via auctions, retail, and e-commerce platforms. Sourced from mints, collectors, and auctions, requiring authentication, grading, and specialized handling.

products.name: Secured Lending (Collateralized Loans)
products.description: Commercial loans originated or acquired, secured by bullion, numismatic coins, and graded sports cards. Requires financial capital, collateral custody, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Precious Metals Storage and Logistics Services
products.description: Secure storage and logistics solutions for precious metals and numismatic coins, including depository services, global shipping, and asset protection. Delivered via owned and third-party facilities with regulated security protocols.

products.name: Minting and Fabrication of Precious Metal Products
products.description: Manufacturing and custom fabrication of silver bullion and proprietary coins/rounds through owned and partner mints. Involves physical production, design, and quality certification.

products.name: Precious Metals Digital Trading Platform
products.description: Online platform enabling customers to buy, sell, and hold fractional digital shares of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bars, with options for physical redemption or storage. Delivered digitally via proprietary websites and mobile interfaces.

products.name: Precious Metals and Numismatics Purchase Programs
products.description: Programs to purchase precious metals and numismatic products from retail customers, providing liquidity and inventory sourcing. Transactions conducted online or by phone, with logistics for secure shipment and payment.

products.name: Auction Services for Rare Coins, Currency, and Fine Wine
products.description: Auctioneering services for rare coins, currency, and fine wine, conducted in-person and online, including consignment, marketing, and sale of high-value collectibles. Requires specialized expertise and regulated handling.

products.name: Omni-Channel Sell-Side Advertising Platform (SSP)
products.description: A technology platform that automates the purchase and sale of digital advertising inventory across all channels (CTV, mobile, desktop) and formats (video, display, audio), delivered via proprietary software and cloud/on-prem infrastructure. Enables real-time auctions, reserve deals, and programmatic guaranteed transactions for publishers and buyers globally.

products.name: Connected TV (CTV) Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of tools and services for publishers to manage and monetize CTV ad inventory, including ad serving, mediation, yield optimization, forecasting, podding logic, and brand safety controls. Delivered via the SpringServe CTV platform, supporting both programmatic and direct-sold video inventory.

products.name: Buyer Tools and Marketplaces
products.description: A suite of digital tools and self-service solutions for advertisers, agencies, and DSPs to discover, curate, and purchase digital ad inventory, including private marketplaces, custom deal packages, and direct access to premium CTV inventory (e.g., ClearLine). Delivered via web-based interfaces and integrated APIs.

products.name: Identity and Audience Solutions
products.description: Digital solutions that enable precise audience targeting and segmentation using first-party and third-party data, integrated within the platform and products like Magnite Curator Marketplace. Delivered as software tools and APIs for buyers and sellers to enrich inventory and campaign targeting.

products.name: Header Bidding and Demand Manager Solutions
products.description: Software solutions for publishers to manage and optimize header-bidding advertising inventory across desktop and mobile, including integrations with major header-bidding standards and proprietary Demand Manager software. Delivered as SaaS and platform integrations.

products.name: Supply Path Optimization (SPO) Services
products.description: Custom integrations and agreements with buyers (agencies, brands, DSPs) to optimize and consolidate media procurement paths, offering preferred partnerships, data flows, and volume-based discounts. Delivered through platform features and direct business relationships.

products.name: Managed Service Campaign Execution
products.description: Campaign management services where Magnite specialists execute and deliver advertising campaigns for brands and agencies on a managed service basis, typically via insertion orders and at negotiated fixed prices. Delivered through a combination of human expertise and platform technology.

products.name: AI-Powered CTV Creative and Campaign Tools (Streamr.ai)
products.description: Artificial intelligence tools that automate the creation of broadcast-quality video ads and streamline CTV campaign setup, enabling small and medium-sized businesses to launch CTV campaigns quickly. Delivered as self-service digital tools integrated into the platform.

products.name: Cardiovascular Gene Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of AAVrh10-based gene therapy candidates delivered intravenously to treat genetically defined cardiovascular diseases, including FA cardiomyopathy (LX2006), PKP2 arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (LX2020), DSP cardiomyopathy (LX2021), and TNNI3-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (LX2022). These therapies are biologic drugs manufactured using baculovirus/Sf9 or HEK293 cell systems and are administered as one-time infusions in clinical settings.

products.name: Alzheimer’s Disease Gene Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of AAVrh10-based gene therapy candidates designed to express protective APOE2 protein in the CNS of APOE4 homozygous patients, including LX1001 (clinical-stage), LX1021 (Christchurch-modified APOE2), and LX1020 (APOE2 expression with APOE4 suppression). These are biologic drugs administered via intracisternal injection for the treatment of genetically defined Alzheimer’s disease.

products.name: Genetically Engineered Atlantic Salmon
products.description: Farm-raised Atlantic salmon genetically engineered for faster growth, produced in land-based recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) farms and sold as high-quality seafood to external customers. Production requires biotechnology expertise, proprietary gene constructs, and physical aquaculture infrastructure.

products.name: Aquaculture Equipment Assets
products.description: Specialized equipment originally intended for use in large-scale RAS aquaculture farms, sold to external buyers as part of asset liquidation. These are physical assets required for the construction and operation of land-based fish farming facilities.

products.name: Intellectual Property for GE Atlantic Salmon
products.description: Patents, trademarks, and proprietary gene constructs related to genetically engineered Atlantic salmon, sold to external parties. Delivery is through legal transfer of intellectual property rights and documentation.

products.name: TV Streaming Devices
products.description: Physical devices such as Roku streaming players, Roku-made TVs, Roku TV smart projectors, and related accessories, manufactured and sold to consumers to enable access to the Roku streaming platform. These are distributed through retail and online channels and require hardware manufacturing and supply chain management.

products.name: Smart Home Products and Services
products.description: A line of Roku-branded smart home devices including cameras, video doorbells, lights, plugs, a home monitoring system, and a mobile application, with optional subscription plans for certain devices. These products are manufactured and sold to consumers, with ongoing service revenue from subscriptions.

products.name: Audio Products
products.description: Roku-branded wireless soundbars, speakers, and subwoofers designed to connect with Roku TVs and streaming devices, sold as physical consumer electronics through retail and online channels.

products.name: TV Streaming Platform (Roku TV OS and Platform Services)
products.description: A digital TV streaming platform powered by the Roku TV OS, licensed to TV OEMs and integrated into Roku devices, providing viewers access to a wide selection of streaming content, and enabling content partners and advertisers to reach audiences. Revenue is generated from licensing, platform fees, and service integrations.

products.name: Owned and Operated Streaming Services (The Roku Channel, Howdy, Frndly TV)
products.description: A portfolio of digital streaming services owned and operated by Roku, including The Roku Channel (AVOD, Live TV, Premium Subscriptions), Howdy (ad-free SVOD), and Frndly TV (live TV, on-demand, cloud DVR). These services aggregate licensed and original content, monetize via ads and subscriptions, and are delivered digitally via the Roku platform and other devices.

products.name: Digital Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital advertising products and services, including in-stream video ads, display ads integrated into the Roku Experience, native ads, sponsorships, and action ads, sold to advertisers and agencies to reach Roku's streaming audience. Includes self-service and programmatic ad buying, measurement, and analytics tools.

products.name: Streaming Services Distribution and Billing
products.description: Distribution and billing services for third-party streaming apps and content partners, including subscription and transaction revenue shares, sale of Premium Subscriptions, and branded app buttons on remote controls. Roku facilitates user signups, payments, and app discovery, earning a share of revenue from partners.

products.name: Crocs Brand Footwear (Clogs, Sandals, and Lifestyle Shoes)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells casual footwear including molded clogs, sandals (wedges, flips, slides), and other lifestyle shoes primarily using proprietary Croslite™ material and comfort-focused technologies. Products are distributed globally through wholesale, retail, and digital channels.

products.name: HEYDUDE Brand Footwear (Loafers, Sneakers, Boots, Sandals)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells casual footwear under the HEYDUDE brand, including iconic loafers (Wally and Wendy), sneakers, boots, and sandals, utilizing lightweight, flexible materials and comfort technologies. Distributed primarily in the U.S. and select international markets via wholesale, retail, and digital channels.

products.name: Footwear Personalization Accessories (Jibbitz™ Charms)
products.description: Designs and sells Jibbitz™ charms and other accessories that allow consumers to personalize their Crocs footwear. These are manufactured and distributed alongside footwear products through the same global channels.

products.name: HEYDUDE Brand Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Offers apparel and accessories under the HEYDUDE brand, designed to complement the footwear line and connect with a broader consumer community. These products are distributed through the same retail and digital channels as HEYDUDE footwear.

products.name: Retail Electric Service
products.description: Provision of electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, oilfield, and public authority customers in Oklahoma and western Arkansas, delivered via owned and operated generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure. Service is regulated and includes various rate and billing options.

products.name: Renewable Energy Programs
products.description: Voluntary programs and rate options that allow customers to purchase electricity generated from renewable sources such as wind and solar, leveraging OG&E's owned and contracted renewable generation assets.

products.name: Demand Response and Load Management Programs
products.description: Programs for commercial and industrial customers that provide incentives or credits for voluntarily reducing or curtailing electricity usage during peak demand periods, including direct load control options.

products.name: Time-of-Use and Variable Pricing Programs
products.description: Alternative rate structures such as time-of-use, variable peak pricing, day-ahead, and flex price options that allow customers to adjust consumption based on price signals or time periods, enabled by smart grid technology.

products.name: Transmission Services
products.description: Provision of electric transmission services, including access to transmission infrastructure and participation in regional transmission markets such as the SPP Integrated Marketplace. Transmission revenues are regulated and distinct from retail sales.

products.name: Lidar Sensing Solutions for Automotive Applications
products.description: High-performance, software-defined active lidar systems designed for integration into passenger and commercial vehicles to enable advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving. These solutions are manufactured in partnership with Tier 1 suppliers and are optimized for long-range detection, high resolution, and flexible vehicle integration.

products.name: Lidar Sensing Solutions for Non-Automotive Applications
products.description: Software-defined lidar sensing platforms adapted for use in rail, construction, mining, agriculture, aerospace, defense, security, foreign-object detection, and intelligent transportation systems. Delivered directly or through system integrators, these solutions leverage the same hardware platform as automotive products, with application-specific software configurations.

products.name: Apollo Lidar Sensor Platform
products.description: A proprietary, modular, software-defined lidar sensor platform providing long-range, high-resolution detection for both automotive and non-automotive markets. The platform supports flexible integration, over-the-air updates, and application-specific configuration without hardware changes.

products.name: STRATOS Lidar Sensor Platform
products.description: An advanced lidar sensor based on the Apollo architecture, offering extended detection range (up to 1.5 kilometers) and higher angular resolution for applications requiring enhanced long-distance performance in automotive, infrastructure, defense, and industrial environments.

products.name: Lidar Software and Perception Solutions
products.description: Software components and perception algorithms that process lidar data, enable adaptive scan patterns, and provide application-specific analytics and workflow integration. These are delivered as part of the sensing platform or through partnerships with third-party software providers for turnkey solutions.

products.name: Hematology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of small and large molecule drugs, including JAKAFI (ruxolitinib), ICLUSIG (ponatinib), MONJUVI/MINJUVI (tafasitamab), and NIKTIMVO (axatilimab), for the treatment of blood cancers and related disorders. These products are manufactured via chemical synthesis or biologic processes and distributed through specialty pharmacies and wholesalers.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A range of targeted therapies, including PEMAZYRE (pemigatinib) and ZYNYZ (retifanlimab), for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies. These are manufactured as small molecule drugs or monoclonal antibodies and distributed globally through specialty and retail channels.

products.name: Inflammation and Autoimmunity Therapeutics
products.description: Therapies for immune-mediated dermatologic conditions, primarily OPZELURA (ruxolitinib) cream, a topical formulation for atopic dermatitis and vitiligo, manufactured via chemical synthesis and distributed through pharmacies.

products.name: Partnered and Out-Licensed Products
products.description: Products discovered by Incyte but commercialized by partners, including OLUMIANT (baricitinib), TABRECTA (capmatinib), and JAKAVI (ruxolitinib, ex-US), for various autoimmune, inflammatory, and oncology indications. Incyte receives royalties and milestone payments; manufacturing and distribution are handled by partners.
